parameters.query: INSERT INTO advisor_decisions (conversation_id, decision_type, ai_provider, ai_model, input_payload, output_payload, validation_result, validation_errors) VALUES (NULLIF($1::TEXT, '')::BIGINT, 'ai_prd_shadow', NULLIF($2::TEXT, ''), NULLIF($3::TEXT, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF($4::TEXT, '')::JSONB, '{}'::JSONB), COALESCE(NULLIF($5::TEXT, '')::JSONB, '{}'::JSONB), CASE WHEN $6::TEXT = 'completed' THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'error' END, CASE WHEN NULLIF($7::TEXT, '') IS NULL THEN '[]'::JSONB ELSE jsonb_build_array($7::TEXT) END) RETURNING id AS shadow_advisor_decision_id;
